Messages.Author: gotcha
Messages.Body:
I know + bleed will not go on masking vampire but I thought this was somewhat different:
what happens if you bleed with Horde n1, no blocks declared, you tap Horde n2&3 .... to increase bleed, then get bounced and then mask with Horde n5?
You lose the +bleed from tappen Hordes I guess, right? And they stay tapped, right?

Horde, The
[dai][obf]
[Baali] Baali
Capacity: 3
Group: 6

Independent: Non-unique. The Horde may tap to give another infernal minion +1 bleed for the current action. Infernal.

Mask of a Thousand Faces
Action Modifier
Obfuscate

[obf] Only usable by a ready, untapped vampire other than the acting minion who is capable of performing the action. Not usable if any action modifiers or other effects have been used that could not have been used if this vampire were the acting vampire. Untap the acting minion and tap this vampire instead. The action continues with this vampire as the acting minion.
[OBF] As above, with +1 stealth.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> gotcha wrote:
> I know + bleed will not go on masking vampire
>
Only built-in +bleed, modifiers are carried to the masking vampire.

> gotcha wrote:
> what happens if you bleed with Horde n1, no blocks declared, you tap Horde n2&3 .... to increase bleed, then get bounced and then mask with Horde n5?You lose the +bleed from tappen Hordes I guess, right?
>
No, Horde n5 gets the +X bleed. See also M1KF and Pentex Loves You:
groups.google.com/d/msg/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/3Wimf1fY3b8/lhPtCoLwDeYJ

> gotcha wrote:
> And they stay tapped, right?
>
Correct.
